reports.text: CT chest without IV contrast. Comparison 6/18/2024 and outside chest radiographs from November 2024. The right lower lobe consolidation seen on the November films has resolved. No pneumothorax. Left upper lobe mass 2.8 cm, unchanged. No new nodules. No effusion.
reports.conclusion: Resolved right lower lobe consolidation. Stable left upper lobe mass. No new disease.

documents.title: Oncology follow-up letter
documents.author: oncology
documents.body:
Outside medical oncology, visit 1/9/2025.

Mr. Coolidge was hospitalized in November with septic shock from pneumonia and a line-related pneumothorax; pembrolizumab was held. Seen here 12/10 recovered, and treatment resumed 12/12. CT 1/7: pneumonia cleared, primary stable at 2.8 cm, no new lesions. Continuing pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks toward a two-year course ending around June. Allergies: sulfa antibiotics, iodinated contrast.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
3-month f/u. Back on pembrolizumab since December, January CT showed the pneumonia cleared and the cancer unchanged.

Has his strength back, he says, though still slow on the stairs as before. On 2 L. Rescue inhaler a few times a week. No fevers since the hospital. Sugars not checked.

Exam: vitals as charted. Alert, conversant. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs diminished, clear of wheeze and crackles. Abd soft. No edema. Feet intact.

A/P: DM2/CKD 3b/HTN stable. BMP, A1c today. Continue regimen. AWV due in June.

documents.title: Pain pill refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: This is Edward's wife writing for him. He is down to 6 of the oxycodone. Can you send more to the pharmacy or does that have to come from the cancer doctor? Thank you.

documents.title: RE: Pain pill refill
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Good morning. The oxycodone is prescribed by his oncology office, so the refill needs to come from them; their nurse line can send it the same day. If they have trouble reaching anyone, call us back and we'll help.

documents.title: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Subsequent AWV, wife along.

Function: still independent in self-care; wife drives. No falls. Hospitalized in November 2024 (septic shock from pneumonia), full recovery. PHQ-9 2, mood good, out on the porch most mild days.

Proxy and wishes unchanged from last year's discussion; HCP form on file names his wife.

Oncology: two-year pembrolizumab course finishing this month.

Exam: vitals as charted. Heart regular. Lungs diminished, no adventitious sounds. No edema. Feet: no lesions, monofilament intact, pulses present.

Prevention: vaccines current through last fall; flu and COVID this fall. Eye exam due July.

Labs: CMP, CBC, lipids, A1c, UACR.

Plan reviewed and printed. RTC September.

reports.text: Noncontrast CT chest. Comparison 1/7/2025. Left upper lobe mass 2.8 cm, unchanged. No new pulmonary nodules. No effusion. No pneumothorax.

documents.title: Oncology letter: completion of immunotherapy
documents.author: oncology
documents.body:
Outside medical oncology, visit 6/24/2025.

Mr. Coolidge received his final scheduled pembrolizumab infusion this week, completing two years of therapy. Disease has been stable throughout; CT 6/20 again shows the left upper lobe mass at 2.8 cm with no new findings. Pembrolizumab is now stopped. Surveillance: noncontrast CT chest every 3 to 4 months and visits here at the same interval. We will continue to prescribe the oxycodone as needed. Allergies: sulfa antibiotics (hives), iodinated contrast (anaphylaxis).

documents.title: Diabetic eye exam report
documents.author: optometry
documents.body: Optometry, exam date 7/22/2025. Dilated exam OU. Corrected acuity 20/25 each eye. Retina: no hemorrhages, exudates or neovascularization; maculae flat. Impression: type 2 diabetes without retinopathy. Return in 12 months.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Wife called; oxygen delivery coming tomorrow morning and they need to be home. Cancelled 9/9, rebooked 9/25 at 9:00 with flu and COVID shots at the same visit.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Rescheduled from 9/9. Done with immunotherapy since June, now on scan surveillance. Eye exam in July without retinopathy.

Doing his usual. Fewer tired days since the infusions stopped. Oxygen 2 L, Combivent as needed. No hospital visits this year.

Exam: on cannula, no distress. Vitals as charted. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs reduced air movement, no wheeze. No pedal edema. Feet intact.

A/P: DM2 with nephropathy, CKD 3b, HTN all steady on current meds. BMP and A1c. Flu (high-dose) and COVID today. Next visit December.

reports.text: CT chest without contrast. Comparison 6/20/2025. Left upper lobe mass 2.8 cm, unchanged. No new nodules or effusion.

documents.title: Oncology surveillance letter
documents.author: oncology
documents.body: Outside medical oncology, visit 10/16/2025. Four months off pembrolizumab. Feels well. Surveillance CT 10/14 unchanged, no progression. Next scan in about four months. Allergies: sulfa, iodinated contrast.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Quarterly. Oncology October letter: surveillance CT stable.

No complaints. Oxygen at baseline. Wife reminds him to drink fluids, he admits he doesn't drink much water. Oxycodone maybe twice a week.

Exam: vitals as charted. Heart regular. Lungs diminished, no wheeze or crackles. Ext without edema. Feet without wounds.

Plan: BMP and A1c. Same medications. Encouraged regular fluids given kidney function. See him in March.
